name: codex-orchestrator
description: Astra-owned native Codex orchestration with economy and balanced cheapest-capable routing.

interface.shortDescription: Astra decides; Luna/Terra execute bounded work.
interface.longDescription: GPT-6 Astra owns architecture and acceptance. Economy uses Luna Medium/maximum-individual for routine bounded execution; balanced adds Terra High for justified engineering judgment. Sol is an explicit user override. Routing distinguishes wait/skip/parent/blocked, applies risk-based fresh review, and keeps accounting outside normal orchestration context.
defaultPrompt: Use $codex-orchestrator:orchestration in balanced mode to plan, build, verify, and review this work.
Use $codex-orchestrator:orchestration in economy mode with Astra decisions and bounded Luna execution.
